candidate_relations.reason: Chronic osteomyelitis matches the 6-month clavicular swelling, overlying wound/erythema, raised ESR, and lytic pathologic fracture.
A generic bone cyst does not account for the inflammatory wound, erythema, and elevated ESR of chronic osteomyelitis.
Fibrous dysplasia is a different developmental bone lesion and does not explain the overlying wound and systemic inflammation.
Langerhans cell histiocytosis is a competing lytic-bone differential, not chronic osteomyelitis.
Multiple myeloma is a different marrow neoplasm and is implausible in a 9-year-old.
Chondroblastoma is a different primary bone tumor, not an inflammatory chronic osteomyelitis.
Unicameral bone cyst is a different cystic lesion and does not explain erythema, wound, and raised ESR.
CRMO is a related chronic osteomyelitis-family diagnosis but is sterile and typically multifocal, conflicting with a unifocal clavicular lesion plus overlying wound.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: sterile autoinflammatory vs infectious chronic OM

candidate_relations.reason: Osteomyelitis is the correct family but omits the required 6-month chronic time course.
Aneurysmal bone cyst is a different expansile lesion and does not capture chronic infection.
Subacute osteomyelitis is related infection but asserts a shorter time/state than the 6-month chronic course.
Osteosarcoma is a different malignant bone tumor, not chronic osteomyelitis.
Giant cell tumor is a different neoplasm and is uncommon in the pediatric clavicle.
Gorham-Stout disease is a different osteolytic entity, not chronic osteomyelitis.
Chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis conflicts with unifocal infectious osteomyelitis suggested by wound and erythema.
Chondrosarcoma is a different malignant cartilage tumor unrelated to this pediatric inflammatory lesion.
Lymphoma is a different malignant differential of a lytic clavicle, not chronic osteomyelitis.
Brown tumor of hyperparathyroidism is a different metabolic lesion and labs do not indicate that process.
Ewing sarcoma is a different malignant bone tumor, not chronic osteomyelitis.
